answer.task: Baseline audit of DOI 10.1021/jacsau.4c00429 fixed-published setup; no results invented, D0 unchanged.

unit_check.details: Feature units are self-consistent for shape descriptors (LabuteASA, PBF, PMI1-3, SPAN, GeDi, Vol, lsd_f, lsd_p in angstrom-based units). ASA (m^2/g) and AV (cm^3/g) are material-level gravimetric quantities, compatible with adsorption modeling. Density is native-scale and carries unit ambiguity between paper table and numeric data (e.g., kg/m^3 vs g/cm^3); treat as standardized internally, report scale uncertainty. PMI units (angstrom^2*amu) are internally consistent; no conversion attempted.

target_check.details: Target s_ads/s_gas with derived entropy loss/R = (1 - ratio)*Sgas/R is dimensionless and physically interpretable. Caveat: linear transformation of target by Sgas couples the control variable Sgas into the target; ensure Sgas is not double-counted when added as a control feature.

redundancy_check.details: Likely redundancy among 3D shape descriptors (SPAN, PBF, GeDi, PMI ratios, ASA, Vol, density are correlated for rigid molecules). First-layer L1=.5 mitigates but does not remove collinearity. Vol vs AV vs density partly redundant. No leakage-prone identifiers, SHAP values, predictions, or adsorption labels are included — controls list is clean.

physical_limitations.details: ANN assumes smooth shape-property relationship; entropy loss includes configurational and adsorbate-specific terms not captured by single-molecule geometry features. Sigmoid output bounds ratio to (0,1) — physically sensible but may saturate near extremes. Convergence-weighted loss emphasizes near-converged samples; poorly converged points may be down-weighted rather than excluded, a physical-data-quality limitation. Model does not encode framework/porosity beyond D0 features, limiting transferability.

risks: Density unit mismatch between paper table and numeric data may cause silent scale inconsistency if mixing sources; resolved only by train-only standardization — flag in any new experiment.
Redundant shape descriptors can inflate apparent feature importance; L1=0.5 may under- or over-regularize relative to paper's original run.
Reproducing 4000 Adam steps lr=1e-4 without fixed seeds is not bit-reproducible; this audit is not a numerical reproduction.
Entropy-loss target derived from Sgas inherits Sgas uncertainty; correlated control feature may leak target information.
Sigmoid output saturation could mask model inability to extrapolate outside trained ratio range.
recommendations: Confirm density units (g/cm^3 vs kg/m^3) against source data files before any new training; document the resolution.
Report feature correlation matrix (PMI ratios, SPAN/PBF/GeDi, Vol/AV/density) to quantify redundancy; optionally run a reduced-feature ablation without changing D0.
Freeze RNG seeds and architecture (191-181-181, ReLU hidden, sigmoid output) in code for reproducibility; report loss curves to verify convergence-weighting behavior.
For new experiments, standardize features and target using train-split statistics only; never re-standardize on full data.
State explicitly in any write-up that this audit covers design/units/controls, not numerical reproduction of published metrics.
answer.scope_statement: Audit only; D0 preserved verbatim; no results generated or modified.
